title: FairEHR-CLP: Towards Fairness-Aware Clinical Predictions with Contrastive Learning in Multimodal Electronic Health Records

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fairness across gender subgroups in clinical prediction tasks using Average Disparity in Equalized Odds (EO) and a novel Error Distribution Disparity Index (EDDI) metric.

Evaluating fairness across racial subgroups (e.g., White, Black, Asian) in clinical prediction tasks using Average Disparity in Equalized Odds (EO) and a novel Error Distribution Disparity Index (EDDI) metric.

Evaluating fairness across ethnicity subgroups (e.g., Latino/Hispanic) in clinical prediction tasks using Average Disparity in Equalized Odds (EO) and a novel Error Distribution Disparity Index (EDDI) metric.
Evaluating fairness across 10-year age bin subgroups in clinical prediction tasks using Average Disparity in Equalized Odds (EO) and a novel Error Distribution Disparity Index (EDDI) metric.

Evaluating fairness across insurance types (e.g., private, government) as a proxy for socioeconomic status in clinical prediction tasks using Average Disparity in Equalized Odds (EO) and a novel Error Distribution Disparity Index (EDDI) metric.
